query:
INSERT INTO low_energy_days (user_id, date)
        SELECT $1, $2::date
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM habit_completions c
            JOIN habits h ON h.id = c.habit_id
            WHERE h.user_id = $1 AND h.archived_at IS NULL AND c.date = $2
        )
        ON CONFLICT (user_id, date) DO NOTHING
